obligations.section: 1. The mechanism is free, the capability is not
obligations.obligation: Owned bindings may change their engine connection mechanism without changing caller capabilities.
obligations.mutation: Require callers to adopt a pinned engine wire protocol when transport changes.

obligations.section: 2. Bidirectional for the whole life of a turn
obligations.obligation: Support a live mid-turn request and response for host tools and approvals.
obligations.mutation: Use a one-way connection that cannot receive an approval answer until the turn ends.

obligations.section: 3. Events arrive live and in order
obligations.obligation: Deliver events during work, in sequence, before the final result.
obligations.mutation: Buffer all events until the provider is done while preserving their apparent order.

obligations.section: 4. Cancellation reaches work already in flight
obligations.obligation: Cancellation reaches running work and still produces one terminal after draining pairs.
obligations.mutation: Cancel only local iteration while the engine continues another effect.

obligations.obligation: Carry complete failure records using registered public codes, with optional mechanism details confined to details.
obligations.mutation: Invent rpc_timeout or replace an error record with a numeric transport status.

obligations.obligation: Carry identifiers, strict JSON, ordered content, exact integers, decimals, registered events, and extensions without loss.
obligations.mutation: Round a large integer at serialization or discard an unknown owned event.

obligations.obligation: Shared connection resources preserve agent and concurrent-session isolation.
obligations.mutation: Route a callback result to another session using one shared mutable current-session slot.

obligations.section: 8. A binding can establish what it is talking to
obligations.obligation: Reject incompatible public contract versions with contract_version_mismatch and unreachable engines with engine_unavailable.
obligations.mutation: Accept a mismatched engine or flatten connection startup failure into internal_failed.

obligations.section: 8. A binding can establish what it is talking to
obligations.obligation: Compare public contract versions without exposing a separately versioned connection protocol.
obligations.mutation: Publish an independent seam protocol version required by external engine authors.

obligations.obligation: No public name, type, error, or artifact reveals engine transport or requires its configuration.
obligations.mutation: Require a caller to configure an engine port or executable path.

obligations.obligation: Connection requirements trace to public promises; limitations cannot narrow a contract or justify per-binding exceptions.
obligations.mutation: Exempt TS from host tools because its selected transport is one-way.

obligations.obligation: Do not freeze engine wire format, framing, or protocol versions for third-party replacement.
obligations.mutation: Publish an external drop-in engine certification protocol.

obligations.obligation: Exclude engine access, binding-specific capabilities, and a supported agent CLI.
obligations.mutation: Export a connectEngine operation or a capability-negotiation method.

obligations.obligation: Grade connection changes through all public binding kits in one change set, without a separate seam harness.
obligations.mutation: Accept a seam-only harness while a public binding loses cancellation.

obligations.obligation: Replacement rewires owned bindings and is accepted through their public scenarios.
obligations.mutation: Certify a replacement binary without running the owned bindings against it.

obligations.obligation: engine-seam/1 versions independently and only adds capabilities without weakening or redefaulting promises.
obligations.mutation: Remove bidirectionality from the same contract major.
